[center][b][size=5]Installation
[/size][/b]
[size=3][i][ prereq: make sure you have [/i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32814][i]shiiteyanyo's caleb mod[/i][/url][i]! ][/i][/size]
[i][size=2]this includes setting up smapi, content patcher, & portraiture :)[/size]
[/i]
﻿
1. drag & drop the folder [caleb alt portraits - kimburs] into [b]Mods > Portraiture > Portraits.[/b]
2. that's it! now you can toggle between the original mod's portraits and these alt portraits in-game [b]with the [P] key.[/b]
if it's blank on launch, you may need to press [P] a couple times!


[i][size=1]huge thank youuu to shiiteyanyo for guiding me through setting this up & for making such a lovely mod!!
